class.name: Spreener
class.brief_description: Abstract class for all Spreeners used by [Spreen].
class.description: Spreeners are objects that perform a specific type of property tween, e.g interpolating a Basis, Vector, Float, etc. A [Spreener] can't be created manually, you need to use a dedicated method from [Spreen].

method.name: get_halflife
method.description: Returns the halflife, in seconds, of the [Spreener].

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether the [Spreener] has finished and the value has met the threshold of reaching the goal.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when the [Spreener] has just finished its job or became invalid (e.g. due to a freed object).
